Maya Tran: FYI pulled the Monday KPI snapshot for the May launch. conversion curve plateaus around day 7 for paid cohorts, looks odd compared to past launches :thinking_face:
Evan Cole: hmm. could be creative fatigue or just attribution quirks. did we change any routing/utm parsing recently?
Maya Tran: not in the campaign plan, but Leah mentioned a small routing backfill last week that touched partner mappings
Leah Park: correct  we migrated some legacy partner tags to canonical utm_content. CRM got backfilled; raw event feed stayed unchanged
Jorge Rivas: that will cause dashboards that read raw events vs CRM to disagree. paste your query and i'll diff against leadflow labels
Maya Tran: ```SELECT cohort_day, channel, count(distinct user_id) as mqls FROM events WHERE launch='may_release' GROUP BY cohort_day, channel ORDER BY cohort_day;```
Tom B: we should add a tiny annotation on the KPI dashboard noting the backfill run id + timestamp. low lift, high signal for readers
ops-bot: leadflow-backfill job completed 2026-03-22T09:23:12Z. processed=7200
Evan Cole: plan: 1) Jorge to run raw vs crm-backfilled series, 2) Leah to pull session traces for a sample of impacted users, 3) Tom to add dashboard annotation, 4) Maya draft a one-paragraph note for PMs
Jorge Rivas: running diff now. will upload CSV to marketing assets in ~15m
Leah Park: pulling 150 session traces focusing on paid/social and any registrants from partner redirects that strip queries
Maya Tran: thanks. if diff shows reclassification, we'll add an "attribution parity" check to next week's KPI pipeline to avoid surprises
Tom B: will add annotation and a toggle on the dashboard to overlay raw vs crm series today (staging -> prod after quick QA)
Evan Cole: great. Jorge, post the CSV link here when ready and i'll add it to the weekly deck
Jorge Rivas: uploaded: https://redwood.internal/files/may_kpi_parity_318765.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya Tran: appreciate the quick triage. meeting in 30 to walk through the CSV and decide exec messaging :thumbsup:
